answer: Planted-honeypot auditing resists sybil graders: the system secretly seeds decoy items whose correct verdict it already knows — an obvious fraud wearing honest plume — into the grading stream. A grader who approves the honeypot reveals it is rubber-stamping, not judging, and a colluding ring driving many keys trips the same planted marble across its whole cluster. Because decoys are unpredictable and look like real work, no sybil knows which item on a grading voyage is checked; systematic honeypot failures across correlated keys flag the operator and strip its standing.
